Pretty good. Doesn't mean it doesn't have its flaws, but a good game nonetheless. If you wanna try it out, buy the normal rebirth, and if you like it, wait for a summer steam-sale, and bulk all the DLC. As someone who plays on repentance+, RP+ or modded normal RP are the best ways to play isaac. beware that the game restricts achievements on modded copies before you beat the boss MOM. (only before, once you've done it, mod away and get those achievements!) Also, the reason i reccomend bulking the dlc is you need AB to get AB+, you need AB+ to get RP, and need RP to get RP+. also, some of the best items are added in the DLCS. If you like rougelikes, this is my top one.
